titulo: Man still haunted by trapped wife’s screams as Airbnb fire killed her and their baby: ‘Doesn’t go away,’ lawsuit says
cuerpo: Exclusive : John Hubbard IV, 40, who lost his wife and their 1-year-old daughter, ‘will never be able to recover from hearing [her] through a trapped door while their lives ended in flames and smoke,’ the former patrolman’s complaint states.
